entries.label: Methods
entries.definition: Example collection for papers whose primary contribution is methodological.
include_when: The reusable method is the paper's primary intellectual contribution.
exclude_when: The method is incidental to an application-first contribution.
boundary_notes: This example is not an approved production taxonomy.

entries.label: Training
entries.definition: Example subcollection for reusable training methods.
include_when: The principal novelty changes how models are trained.
exclude_when: Training is standard and the application result is the primary contribution.
boundary_notes: Compare against the nearest sibling before classification.
